name.value: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve of Canada - Visitor Centre

description.value: The Pacific Rim National Park Reserve Visitor Centre is the main Parks Canada gateway to one of BC's most iconic stretches of coastline, spanning Long Beach, the West Coast Trail, and the Broken Group Islands. Operated by Parks Canada on the traditional territories of the Nuu-chah-nulth First Nations, it serves as the orientation hub for visitors exploring kilometres of sandy beaches and old-growth temperate rainforest. Touring cyclists riding the Pacific Rim Highway will find this a natural stopping point before or after riding the Long Beach area, which is explicitly listed as a cycling destination within the park.
